replicate_statements: The data are presented as mean ± SD. Statistical analysis involved Student's t‐test and one‐way ANOVA followed by post hoc Tukey's HSD (honestly significant difference) test.
outputs.explanation: The bar graphs quantify band intensities with mean ± SD error bars and statistical tests, so replicate reporting is required. An n-number (N=4) is given on the mitochondrial fraction graph, but the legend never states what this N represents (e.g., number of mice, independent blots, or technical replicates), so the type of replicate is not reported.
This panel shows representative immunoelectron micrographs without any quantification, averaging, or statistical summary, so replicate number/type reporting is not required for this panel.
This panel is a single representative Western blot comparing different purification methods, with no quantification, averaging, or statistics presented, so replicate reporting is not required.
This panel is a single representative Western blot from a proteinase protection assay with no quantification, averaging, or statistical analysis, so replicate reporting is not required.
